ladder.note: dedicated OCR engine (2.1 GB, 1.1B) — pass-1 workhorse on any box
strong verifier — needs ~27 GB; on this 96 GB workstation
35B MoE vision (Q4 21 GB) — needs num_ctx pin, sees CUDA IMA without one
35B MoE bf16 — last local tier on this 96 GB workstation

reconcileWith.note: must differ from pass-1 model; falls back to the first other healthy ladder entry

textLayer.note: page used as-is when its embedded text passes the gate; otherwise rasterized + OCR'd

cloud.caveats: Images are normalized to ~800x800 px (cap 384 tokens). Dense small-font tables: prefer local tiers; treat cloud as independent 2nd opinion / fallback only. Requires -CloudOk per run + $env:DEEPSEEK_API_KEY + explicit user consent.
